title: Train Interlocking Registry Schema
description: Schema for plan/_trains/_interlockings.yaml — the registry of train interlockings (issue #1248). Mirrors the plan/_trains.yaml train registry: a thin index pointing at the canonical plan/_trains/_interlockings/<id>.yaml documents. The interlocking files remain authoritative; this registry is discovery metadata only.

path.description: Canonical path to the interlocking YAML relative to repo root (plan/_trains/_interlockings/<id>.yaml).
